cleartext.title: Unencrypted connection
cleartext.body: The connection to {{host}} isn't encrypted. Your username and app password would be sent in clear text over the network.
cleartext.warning: Anyone between this phone and the server — the Wi-Fi operator, your internet provider, any network in between — can read your password and your boards and cards. A Nextcloud app password grants access to your whole account, not just Deck.
cleartext.remedy: Safer options: reach the server through a VPN such as Tailscale or WireGuard, or set up a free certificate with DuckDNS and Let's Encrypt.

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Changes you make are saved on this device first, then sent to your Nextcloud server in the background, even after working offline. Anything still waiting, rejected by the server, or overwritten by a newer change on the server shows up here.
sync.discardMsg: This change will be permanently lost and cannot be recovered.
